description: Close a tab by tabId or session name (default: the current tab). Tabs not opened by PolterTab — including ones adopted via browser_session_create({tabId}) — require the user's permission: the tool returns code needs_user_permission with the tab's id, title and url; ask the user, then retry with force: true. A tabId that does not exist in Chrome returns tab_not_found. Closing the current tab leaves no current tab; untargeted calls then error until you switch or navigate.

force.description: Close a tab the user opened. Only when the user asked.

name: browser_tab_close
